LanguageData.SSC_Preconception_GenderTip: Set the preferred sex for offspring from a new pregnancy.
LanguageData.SSC_Preconception_SpeciesTip: Choose whether offspring use your species or the partner's, such as human or an alien race; gene inheritance is unaffected.
LanguageData.SSC_Preconception_ImprintTip: Choose whether offspring receive the initial Child of Lust imprint at birth, without copying a parent's differentiated imprint. The birth effect will be added later.
LanguageData.SSC_Preconception_ImprintLocked: Requires completed ordinary fertility specialization training
LanguageData.SSC_Preconception_PregnancyBlocked: Fetal control cannot be changed during pregnancy or labor
LanguageData.SSC_Preconception_FertilityDisabled: Fertility is disabled; these preferences do not apply to new pregnancies
LanguageData.SSC_Preconception_MissingUterus: Fetal control: requires completed uterus development
